sloka: सो ऽहं शासनमाज्ञाय धनदस्य महात्मनः ।त्वत्सकाशमनुप्राप्तो निर्विशङ्कः प्रतीक्ष माम् ।। ७.४१.९ ॥
transliteration: so 'haṁ śāsanamājñāya dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ ।tvatsakāśamanuprāpto nirviśaṅkaḥ pratīkṣa mām ।। 7.41.9 ॥

translations.english: Having understood the command of the great-souled Kubera, I have arrived in your presence; therefore, wait for me without any apprehension.
